title: Checklists
summary: Comprehensive pre-rehearsal, performance, and safety checklists for ministry production teams.
content:
“But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way.”— 1 Corinthians 14:40

Production & Rehearsal Checklists

Purpose

Checklists create consistency, reduce stress, and protect against oversight.They ensure that every role — from director to volunteer — begins each rehearsal or service ready, safe, and unified in purpose.

🎭 Rehearsal Readiness Checklist

TaskResponsibilityStatus
Room and stage area clearedStage Manager / Tech Team☐
Scripts, music, and cue sheets distributedProducer / Director☐
Props and costumes set in placeProps / Costume Teams☐
Lighting and sound testedTech Team☐
Devotional material preparedDirector / Ministry Lead☐
Attendance confirmedProducer☐
Prayer and opening remarks completeDirector / Choral Director☐

🔊 Technical Setup Checklist

TaskResponsibilityStatus
All microphones tested and labeledAudio Lead☐
Monitor and main speakers balancedSound Engineer☐
Lighting cues loaded and verifiedLighting Operator☐
Stage cables secured and tapedTech Crew☐
Projector or slides testedMedia Operator☐
Backup batteries availableTech Team☐
Power-off checklist posted backstageStage Manager☐

🕯️ Performance Night Checklist

TaskResponsibilityStatus
All team members signed inProducer☐
Costumes and props inspectedCostume / Props Leads☐
Tech booth communication testedTech Lead☐
Cue books placed and labeledStage Manager☐
Pre-service prayer completedDirector / Pastor☐
Audience seating and safety confirmedUshers / Hospitality☐
Emergency exits clearFacilities Team☐

⚙️ Post-Performance Checklist

TaskResponsibilityStatus
Power down lighting and sound systemsTech Team☐
Return and store all propsProps Team☐
Clean and reset stage areaVolunteers / Facilities☐
Collect unused scripts and materialsProducer☐
Debrief session and prayerLeadership Team☐
Update change log if adjustments madeDocumentation Lead☐

💡 Ministry Focus

Preparation is an act of worship.Checklists protect time, preserve peace, and honor those who serve — creating an orderly environment where the Spirit can move freely.
